calculate percentage yield

kg_points_with_parent.point_title: Yield (actual yield)
Factors reducing yield
Counting the wrong number or type of bonds in bond-energy calculations (ignoring balancing numbers)
Explaining a catalyst's effect as particles gaining energy or moving more quickly
Failing to convert cm3 to dm3 in concentration calculations
Saying covalent bonds are broken when simple molecular substances melt or boil (instead of weak intermolecular forces)
Obtaining crystals by evaporating to dryness
Quoting the molar enthalpy change as the unconverted joule value (e.g. 50 000) instead of kilojoules
Predicting that a pressure change shifts equilibrium to the side with fewer gas molecules in the wrong direction
Balancing equations by altering subscripts
Predicting that raising the temperature shifts equilibrium in the exothermic direction
Drawing gas particles touching each other or joined by bonds
Saying graphite layers are held together by bonds (instead of weak forces of attraction between the layers)
Describing ionic bonding as attraction between atoms or molecules (or as intermolecular forces)
Believing ionic compounds conduct electricity because electrons move and carry the charge
Believing isotopes of an element differ in their number of protons
Calling the Periodic Table relative atomic mass the mass number
